question: Trump renames AI by September 30?
requirements: This market will resolve to "Yes" if Donald Trump signs an executive order, proclamation, or presidential memorandum that adopts a new official name for artificial intelligence, or directs a federal agency or the federal government to adopt one, by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET.
A qualifying action must replace or supersede "artificial intelligence" as the federal government's designation for the technology itself.
Any replacement name qualifies, including "Superior Intelligence", "Extreme Intelligence", "Supreme Intelligence", or "Genius Intelligence"; the name chosen has no bearing on resolution.
An order that directs an agency to adopt or implement such a name within a stated period qualifies.
exclusions: Statements, speeches, interviews, press conferences, and social media posts, including polls posted to social media, do not count.
Renaming a federal office, agency, program, task force, commission, or military service, such as an "AI Force", does not count unless the same action also renames the technology itself.
Renaming a specific product, model, or private-sector system does not count.
Incidental use of an alternative term in the text of an order, without a directive adopting it as the official designation, does not count.
context: Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The signing or issuance of a qualifying order within this market's timeframe will qualify for a "Yes" resolution, regardless of when the order takes effect, and regardless of whether it is subsequently stayed, enjoined, revoked, or superseded.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the government of the United States, including the text of presidential actions published at whitehouse.gov and in the Federal Register; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
